summary: Gate ticket process queues with revision-bound admission

delivery.outcome: A closed POA v2 queue-admission contract and reference conformance require one existing ticket, current queue revision, exact plan hash, independent admission, same-ticket replan after rejection and higher authority for irreversible effects before an exact start command can launch any URI Process.
nonGoals: Do not implement or deploy a scheduler daemon in Wellmanifest
Do not grant authority to a URI, transport, LLM, MCP session or schema
Do not bypass an admission rejection or execute stale plan bytes
Do not mutate Subactor runtime repositories in this ticket
Do not merge or self-approve the publication

architecture.decision: Publish additive v2 queue-plan, admission, replan and view documents rather than changing closed v1 objects; keep the adapter deterministic and make Subactor responsible for runtime adoption.
dataChanges: Add the poa.queue-plan/v2, poa.queue-admission/v2, poa.queue-replan/v2, poa.queue-start/v2 and poa.queue-admission-view/v2 document family
architecture.rollback: Revert the additive v2 files and adapter changes; immutable v1 queue and process contracts remain available.
